reasoning_content: The command failed likely because `which dotnet` returned nonzero, or dotnet --info. Let me check dotnet separately.

action.command: which dotnet; echo "exit=$?"; dotnet --version 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; ls /usr/share/dotnet 2>/dev/null; ls /root/.dotnet 2>/dev/null; cat /etc/os-release | head -5

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "which dotnet; echo \"exit=$?\"; dotnet --version 2>&1; echo \"exit=$?\"; ls /usr/share/dotnet 2>/dev/null; ls /root/.dotnet 2>/dev/null; cat /etc/os-release | head -5", "summary": "Check dotnet installation"}
